Reading guide: a profile describes EVIDENCE, it is not a finding. Mild overdispersion (x2.5-6.5) is the normal texture of this book and is never by itself an anomaly; small age/duration cells (tiny expected counts) are unreliable however extreme their A/E looks.

Name it as an entry of its own with that single year and direction; keep a dispersion entry as well if you believe the wider stretch is erratic (the two readings are not exclusive)
  onset: max 1yr move / excursion size = 2.06 (the biggest single-year move EXCEEDS the net excursion — the line oscillates rather than holding a new level, so the shape here is dispersion: give this line a dispersion entry over these years, and keep the level-change reading as an entry of its own too.
